title: IterCAD: Iterative Program Repair for CAD Code Generation from Orthographic Views
abstract: arXiv:2608.24020v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating executable parametric CAD code from dimension-annotated orthographic drawings is a challenging task requiring geometric understanding, procedural reasoning, and precise numerical prediction. Existing vision-language approaches typically formulate this problem as one-shot generation, preventing the model from inspecting intermediate CAD results and correcting early mistakes, often leading to non-executable code or geometrically inconsistent outputs. In this paper, we propose IterCAD, an iterative framework that reformulates orthographic-view-to-CAD generation as a progressive program repair process. Instead of predicting the final CAD code in a single pass, IterCAD repeatedly analyzes the current CAD result, reasons about its discrepancy with the target views, and explicitly decides whether to REVISE the code or STOP the refinement process. translated_title: IterCAD：基于正交视图的CAD代码生成的迭代程序修复方法
translated_abstract: 从带尺寸标注的正交图纸生成可执行的参数化CAD代码是一项具有挑战性的任务，需要几何理解、过程推理和精确数值预测。现有的视觉-语言方法通常将这一问题表述为一次性生成，这阻碍了模型检查中间CAD结果并纠正早期错误，常常导致不可执行的代码或几何不一致的输出。在本文中，我们提出了IterCAD，一种迭代框架，将正交视图到CAD的生成重新表述为渐进式程序修复过程。IterCAD不是一次性预测最终CAD代码，而是反复分析当前CAD结果，推理其与目标视图的差异，并明确决定是修订代码还是停止细化过程。为了使迭代修复可学习，我们进一步构建了IterCAD-RS，一个结构化的修订数据集。
tldr: IterCAD通过迭代修复框架，将正交视图到CAD代码生成从一次性预测改为渐进式修复，显著提升代码可执行性和几何一致性。
en_tdlr: IterCAD reformulates orthographic-view-to-CAD generation as iterative program repair, enhancing code executability and geometric consistency.
